paragraphs: From Wexford test centre, depart Whitemill and continue to the end of the road
Turn left onto New Line Road take your 1st right into Richmond Drive
Turn left into Richmond Court where you will be asked to carry out a turnabout (U-turn) before pulling in
When ready, move off again and turn right back onto Richmond Drive, followed by a right onto New Line Road
At the roundabout, go straight ahead onto Distillery Road
Turn right onto Mill Road, keep slight left to stay on Mill Road
Turn left into Faythe Lane turn right onto The Faythe, and shortly after take a right into Rockview Court
Follow the road around, complete another turnabout, and make your way back out of Rockview Court onto The Faythe, this time turning left
At the end of the road turn right onto Swan View
Left onto Lambert Place, and left again onto Upper King Street
Take your 1st right onto Joseph Street turn left onto Roche's Road
Continue straight ahead onto School Street, which becomes Lower John Street, then Upper John Street, then Newtown Road
Keep straight through this stretch and watch your speed as the name changes
Turn left onto the Wexford Inner Relief Route
Left into Oak Tree Rise and right into Trees Avenue for a quiet estate stop
Move off again turn left along Trees Avenue, complete a turnabout, then retrace right onto Trees Avenue and left onto Oak Tree Rise
At the end of the road turn left back onto the Wexford Inner Relief Route
At the next roundabout go straight ahead, then at the end of the road turn left onto Clonard Road
Take your 1st right onto Clonard Avenue, continue straight as it becomes Liam Mellows Park, and at the end of the road turn right onto Whitemill Road
At the roundabout take the slight left exit for New Line Road, then straight through the next mini-roundabout, and turn left to arrive at Whitemill for a brief stop
To finish, depart Whitemill, take a left and then a right to rejoin New Line Road, and continue through the two roundabouts staying on New Line Road
At the next roundabout turn right into Whitemill Industrial Estate
Left to stay in the estate, left onto Clonard Road, and right into Heathfield to return toward the Wexford test centre
